title: The Itinerant Archivist
openingText: The scholar doesn't look up from his rubbing of the ruin wall. 'You're standing in my light,' he says mildly. 'But since you're here: you have hands, a guard of some competence, and presumably a price. I have questions that need feet. Shall we trade?'
dialogueWalkaway: This conversation has ceased to be instructive. Good day.
dialogueAccept: Signed and witnessed. Knowledge, like coin, appreciates when it moves.
confidence: The Wardens have not funded Vey in two seasons. The stipend comes out of his own purse.

clauses.text: Vey shares his survey of the surrounding ruin: the ground around it charted, and fuel enough for the castle to cross it twice.
A stipend of 30 gold for escorting his samples to the next waystone.
A quiet clause granting the Wardens first claim on anything you recover here, at 25 gold of your salvage.
He offers to annotate your guild's charts with a fragment of pre-Collapse cartography.
The location of a site they have catalogued and no one else has walked
Your field notes from the road
You carry their samples to the next waystone
Reading rights in your guild's library
